name: What factors influence the cost of hanging new drywall?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of hanging new drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs to hang new drywall depend primarily on square footage, ceiling height, sheet accessibility, and whether demolition and disposal are involved. Straightforward rectangular rooms with standard eight-foot ceilings cost less per square foot than basements with low ductwork or multi-story entryways requiring scaffolding. The scope of work also affects pricing: hiring a team that coordinates framing adjustments, drywall installation, and final painting in one contract reduces handoff delays compared to hiring separate trade specialists for every small task. Detailed on-site evaluations provide the most accurate project estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on total square footage, ceiling heights, board accessibility, job complexity like soffits or cutouts, and whether framing fixes are needed.
